% A guard, for files of the document named like a .4ht file: a copy of
% the algorithmic package in the document's folder, as some documents
% ship one. As in the PDF, each line of the algorithm is a line of its
% own.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{algorithmic}
\begin{document}
\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\STATE first line
\STATE second line
\IF{a test}
\STATE third line
\ENDIF
\end{algorithmic}
\end{document}
